resolutions.earlier_suggestion: 登录信息仍已保存。稍后重试，或选择其他模型。
resolutions.applied: 登录信息仍已保存。稍后重试，或选择其他模型。
resolutions.judgement: Applied verbatim, and it is an improvement rather than a preference: it removes the 'saved … still retained' duplication (已保存的登录信息仍然保留) and reproduces the sentence the locale already ships for the same English fact (ui.settings.integrations.integration_model.the_sign_in_is_still_saved = 登录信息仍已保存。), so the two surfaces now agree word for word. 仍已保存 is formal but established in this catalogue; it asserts the credential is still stored and never implies loss or expiry, which is what the sidecar forbids. The remedy clause keeps the catalogue's 稍后重试 / 选择其他模型 pair.
resolutions.checked: grep '仍已保存' -> ui.settings.integrations (shipped) + this key; both now identical in the first sentence.

resolutions.earlier_suggestion: 此会话运行{label}，但登录不可用，因此在连接之前无法作答。
resolutions.applied: 此会话运行{label}，但登录不可用，因此在连接之前无法作答。
resolutions.judgement: Applied verbatim. 登录不可用 names the state the catalogue already has words for (未登录{label}, 登录信息) instead of turning 'a working sign-in' into an object (可用的登录), and it still does not blame an expired credential, which the sidecar reserves for the sibling arm. {label} stays verbatim and unspaced from the CJK run, as the guide requires; the objectless 在连接之前 is right here because the remedy is the band's own connect control.
